simple.meaning: אַךְ (ʼak) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a particle of affirmation , surely ; hence (by limitation) only.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 161 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 11 more, beginning at Genesis 7:23. Its contexts include family, family line, blood, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַךְ (H389).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אַךְ (ʼak) / H389 is traced through Genesis 7:23, Genesis 9:4, Genesis 9:5, Genesis 18:32 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: a particle of affirmation , surely ; hence (by limitation) only
definitions.usage: also, in any wise, at least, but, certainly, even, howbeit, nevertheless, notwithstanding, only, save, surely, of a surety, truly, verily, wherefore, yet (but).
definitions.full: H389. ak אַךְ 159 adverb (perhaps from the same demonstr, root found also in כֵּן כֹּה, כִּי, ). 1 surely . 2 with a restrictive force, emphasizing what follows : a. in contrast to what precedes, howbeit ; b. in contrast with other ideas Generally , only 1 asseverative, often introducing with emphasis the expression of a truth (or supposed truth) newly perceived, especially in colloquial language, surely, no doubt (doch wohl) ; Gen 26:9 הִוא אִשְׁתְּךָ הִנֵּה אַךְ of a surety , lo, she is thy wife ! 29:14 ; 44:28 ; Judg 3:24 ; 20:39 ; 1Sam 16:6 surely the anointed of ׳י is before him ! 25:21 ; Jer 5:4 ; Psalm 58:12; Psa 73:1 ; 73:13 ; but also in other cases, though rarely, Isa 34:14-15 , Zeph 3:7 ; Psa 23:6 ; 139:11 ; Psalm 140:14; Job 16:7 ; 18:21 ; & rather singularly Exod 12:15 ; 31:13 ; Lev 23:27 , 39 (all P). 2 restrictive : a. in contrast to what precedes , howbeit, yet, but : Gen 9:4 howbeit , flesh with the life thereof . . . ye shall not eat, 20:12 ; Exod 21:21 ; Lev 21:23 ; 27:26 ; Num 18:15 , 17 ; 2Sam 3:13 ; Jer 10:24 correct me, בְּמִשְׁמָּט אַךְ but with judgment, Job 2:6 ; 13:15 ; sometimes with an adversative force, as Isa 14:15 ; 43:24 ; before an imperative (minimizing the request), Gen 23:13 only , if thou wilt, I pray thee, hear me ! 27:13 ; Judg 10:15 ; 1Sam 18:17 ; 1Kin 17:13 and elsewhere So 1Sam 8:9 כִּי אַךְ (see כִּי ; and compare πλὴν ὅτι ). b. in contrast to other ideas Generally : — ( α ) Gen 7:23 ; 18:32 הַמַּעַם אַךְ only this once (so Exod 10:17 and elsewhere) 34:15 ; 12:16 (note accents), 1Sam 18:8 תַמְּלוּכָה אַךְ לוֺ וְעוֺד and there yet remains for him only the kingdom, 21:5 ; Isa 45:14 אֵל בְּךָ אַךָ only in thee is God! Psa 62:2 etc. Job 14:22 ; Psa 37:8 fret not thyself לְהָרֵעַ אַךְ (which leadeth) only to do evil, Prov 11:24 he that withholdeth more than is meet לְמַחְסוֺר אַךְ (tendeth) only to penury, 14:23 ; 21:5 ; 22:16 ; ( β ) attaching itself closely to the following word (usually an adjective, rarely a verb), only , i.e. exclusively, altogether, utterly Deut 16:15 and thou shalt be שָׂמֵחַ אַךְ altogether rejoicing, 28:29 (compare 28:33 רַק ) Isa 16:7 נְכָאִים אַךְ utterly stricken, 19:11 ; Jer 16:19 nought but lies, 32:30 ; Hosea 12:12 ; Job 19:13 זָרוּ אַךְ are wholly estranged (with play on אַכְזָר cruel ). c. as an adverb of time (with infinitive absolute), twice: Gen 27:30 בָּא יַעֲקֹבוְ֗֗֗עֵשָׂו יָצָא יָצאֹ אַךְ only just (or scarcely ) had Jacob gone out, . . . and (= when) Esau came in, Judg 7:19 . — וְאַח thrice : Gen 9:5 and only (second limitation of 9:3 ); Num 22:20 but only ; Josh 22:19 but howbeit. Note. — In some passages the affirmative and restrictive senses agree equally with the context; and authorities read the Hebrew differently. Thus only = nought but, altogether , is adopted by Ges Ew Hi De in Psa 23:6 ; 62:10 ; 73:1 ; 73:13 ; by Ew Hi De in 39:6 ; 39:7 (Che surely ); by Ges Ew De in 39:12 (but Hi Che surely ); by Ew Hi in 73:18 (De Che surely ); by Ges Hi De in 139:11 (Ew doch ). Isa 45:14 Ges Ew Hi Di only ; but De Che of a truth .
